QuestInfo.name: Beating Heat Stroke
QuestInfo.1: Icarus just adores his new hobby: hang gliding. Unfortunately, too much hang gliding in this heat has given him heat stroke! Some #e#bForeverfreeze ice#k#n from the Ice Pillar should fix him right up, though. Collect some from the #b#eIce Pillars#n#k that can be found throughout Maple World and help Icarus cool off.

0.0: Hi t-there! I'm f-f-fine. R-really! I've been hang gliding off the t-top of Perion 'cause hang gliding's the b-best thing EVER, but now I can't s-stop sweating. Or t-throwing up. The pharmacist s-says I have h-heat stroke, but what d-does he know? But maybe you should g-get me some #e#bForeverfreeze Ice#k#n, like he prescribed.

yes.0: You c-c-can get Foreverfreeze Ice f-from #b#eIce Pillars#k#n that appear all over Maple World. Just s-smack 'em. Get me #b#e20 p-p-pieces of Foreverfreeze Ice#k#n, okay?

no.0: Oh, w-well. I j-just hope I don't throw up on anyone when I hang glide off the t-top of Perion later.
